verdict_reason: The test correctly drops BRANCH_ADDRESS with exact positive assertions that track PARTIES, but its new role-list constant takes a second name for a concept the source already names.

todos.issue: The new test constant JOURNEY_SELECTABLE_ROLES (seed-address-book.test.js:7) names the same concept the module under test calls SELECTABLE_ADDRESS_ROLES (seed-address-book.js:8): the address-book roles the journey lets a user pick an address by. One concept, two names across the test and its source.
todos.fix: Must: the test and the module under test use one name for the list of address-book roles the journey selects addresses by. One way: rename the test constant to SELECTABLE_ADDRESS_ROLES, matching seed-address-book.js:8.
